anchors.description: Straight-line diameter chord across the orange basketball resting on the black leather office chair: from the ball's left silhouette rim to its opposite lower-right silhouette rim at roughly equator height.
anchors.visible_evidence: Pink-orange spherical ball with black channel seams sits on the chair seat behind the desk; its silhouette spans about 61 px across at the equator, and the two endpoints lie on nearly opposite rims (bright left edge vs dark lower-right edge), so the chord is essentially the sphere's diameter.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: No brand or size markings legible at this resolution; assumed a regulation size-7 basketball (0.239 m diameter). A size-6/youth ball (0.22-0.23 m) or a slightly deflated ball would lower the value by up to ~10%.
